summary: Runway 09R/27L entry and exit point NB11/N11 closed at London Heathrow Airport due to work in progress.
text:
RWY 09R/27L ENTRY/EXIT POINT NB11/N11 CLOSED DUE WIP. A/C DEARTING
FM TERMINALS 2,3 AND 5 THAT REQUIRE FULL LENGTH DEP FM RWY 09R ARE
TO ADVISE DELIVERY WHEN REPORTING READY FOR PUSH.
